question: Does one cash-capped re-entry after the original 2R partial has closed improve the existing OKX 2/3-at-2R plus 1/3 cloud-runner funded account?
single_variable: At most one additional position per originally funded signal: buy back the already-closed 2/3 partial at the first existing profit-confirm-entry H1 open, after its completed 12H close confirms the original shadow at +2R.

baseline.position: 2/3 maker limit at 2R plus 1/3 unchanged original cloud runner
baseline.selection_and_order: Existing value-based 90-day eligibility, original per-entry low-prior-ATR order, same-contract exclusion, and funded event set from cloud_close_eligibility_repair/thirds

reentry.source_semantics: Reuse the previously generated real-signal 12H confirmation path; shadow PnL is never credited.
reentry.partial_fill_gate: The matching original 2R target leg must have exited in a strictly earlier H1 bar than the re-entry open.
reentry.runner_live_gate: The original runner must remain open at the re-entry H1 open; an original open-phase exit at that same timestamp is already closed and disqualifies the candidate.
reentry.direction: Same symbol and side as the original funded event.
reentry.entry: Exact H1 opening quote at the existing profit-confirm-entry confirmation boundary.
reentry.protective_exit: Reuse the existing +0.5 original-R protected shadow path and its native exit; if the original runner exits in an earlier phase of the same H1 bar, synchronize the add-on close to the runner fill. Require the shadow exit no later than the runner exit. Same-bar unequal stop fills require an OHLC barrier-order proof.
reentry.frequency: At most one re-entry for each original funded signal; no new signal or shadow trade is added.

capital_and_execution.max_addon_notional: Minimum of the actually funded original 2R leg entry notional and VectorBT current free cash at the order callback.
capital_and_execution.leverage: None; lock cash for every long and short order; never permit a negative-cash fill.
capital_and_execution.same_open_priority: All original target/runner callbacks retain their frozen per-slot order and run before add-on callbacks at the same H1 open; add-ons may consume only remaining free cash.
capital_and_execution.original_runner: Unchanged; the same original slot remains occupied through runner exit, and the re-entry closes no later than the runner.
capital_and_execution.fees: Original market entries and market/stop exits taker 5bp per fill; original 2R resting target maker 2bp; re-entry entry and exit taker 5bp each.
capital_and_execution.slippage: Zero in the registered actual case; optional 5bp per market fill only if the development gate passes.
capital_and_execution.not_included: Perpetual funding, book impact, exchange liquidation tiers, and capacity beyond available cash.

evaluation.development_gate: At least 100 closed position rows, net win rate >=30%, equal-notional net payoff >=2.5, USDT net payoff >=2.5, and conservative OHLC DD bound <=35%.
evaluation.conditional_checks: Only after development passes, evaluate the pre-existing matched control path, paired actual subset, and +5bp market-fill slippage.
evaluation.accounting: One shared 1000U VectorBT cash account; record actual quantity, per-position fee-net cash PnL, NAV, intrahour OHLC upper/lower NAV and conservative drawdown bound. Primary win/payoff metrics count one row per original parent with add-on PnL merged into it; report add-on legs separately without double-counting them.
evaluation.zero_add_reconciliation: Before the reinvestment case, run the same local callback with add-ons disabled and require all 1,569 frozen original event cash PnLs/notionals plus every hourly NAV/open/upper/lower field to match the frozen funded account. Stop if this parity gate fails.

implementation.engine: VectorBT Portfolio.from_order_func with cash_sharing=true and local account callback
implementation.source_quotes: Existing OKX H1 bars loaded by cloud_close_reward_account.quotes
